module: Flowgraph node "Track Vehicle Parking" (default category). Enables parking tracking for a vehicle (gameplay_parking.enableTracking) and outputs enter/exit (pulses), inside/outside, spotExists and spot (target spot, parkingSpotData). Input reset: disables tracking and resets the state.

reset.desc: Disables the vehicle's tracking and sets the inside/outside/spotExists outputs back to false.

work.desc: Enables tracking if needed, reads getTrackingData()[vehId] and detects parked / not parked transitions.
